text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno is running in an exhibition race today.
It's an event hosted by Tracen Academy so fans can enjoy racing on a deeper level.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Mm. Wearing this outfit makes my posture straighten right up. It brings me back to my roots.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"To be worthy of this outfit—
I resolved to be righteous, just like my father."
choice_data_list: Your dad was a police officer, right?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes... He is a great father whom I deeply respect.
From my childhood days, all the way to this very day—

text_block_list.name: Young Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Dad, are you heading to work already?
You were back late yesterday too... Are you holding up okay?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, I'm fine.
This is the critical moment, I can't afford to rest."

text_block_list.name: Young Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: The critical juncture... is that really important?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed.
If wrongdoers are left unchecked, peace is shattered.
And when peace is shattered, people get hurt."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno's Father
text_block_list.text:
Upholding justice and protecting peace is my mission—
I'm heading out, Fenomeno.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"On the day he left saying that, my father appeared
on the breaking news, capturing a dangerous criminal."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
My father, fulfilling his duty of justice, was especially radiant.
He became the figure I truly admired.
choice_data_list: I see... So that's how you felt.
I see... So that's how you felt.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Today, I shall make everyone feel
the justice burning within this chest, sir!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then came the time for the exhibition race.
Fenomeno stood on the turf with an expression so serious
you'd never guess it was just an event.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I've heard the rumors.
You're quite fast, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I came prepared with a secret plan.
Hehe... victory will be mine."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose either, sir!
Let us both do our absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the event race got underway, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A single Umamusume leaped straight to the front. Her horseshoes tear at the turf, sending clods of dirt flying behind her...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that makes it so hard for the girls behind her to run~.
I guess that kind of thing is allowed...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(...Racing isn't just about lofty ideals.
Everyone is ravenous for victory.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: "However... my way of fighting is different. I will run holding my head high, staying righteous through and through!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"I will uphold justice! The righteous will prevail!
Just like my father, I'll prove it!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The flying clods of turf don't faze Fenomeno one bit!
Majestic and dignified, she shows off her valiant stride!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno claims victory in the special match!
A run that pierces straight through the cloudless blue sky!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the special match, Fenomeno
was invited to the talk show as the winner and made an appearance.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Now then, does anyone have a question for
Fenomeno-san? Please raise your hand!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Yes! You were so cool!
What do you think about when you run?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I only have one thing in mind.
To be righteous and strong, just like my police officer father!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"When I wear this outfit,
those feelings grow even stronger."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
And today, righteous deeds have been rewarded.
I am deeply moved!

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Um... what should I do
to run like you, big sister...?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Let us harbor a spirit of justice in our hearts!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Righteousness will surely lead to victory, sir!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amidst the thunderous applause,
the full schedule of the event races came to a close.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Mmm! What a truly refreshing feeling this is, yes sir!
choice_data_list: Seeing you stay true to justice really moved me.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Boss... thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Please continue to watch over me from by my side as I strive to walk the right path!
choice_data_list: I'm so proud to be your trainer!
I'm so proud to be your trainer!
Didn't that bring you one step closer to your dad?
Didn't that bring you one step closer to your dad?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Please continue to watch over me from by my side as I strive to walk the right path!
choice_data_list: I'm so proud to be your trainer!
I'm so proud to be your trainer!
Didn't that bring you one step closer to your dad?
Didn't that bring you one step closer to your dad?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I am your pride...!
That is far more honor than I deserve...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I intend to keep honing a righteous heart so as not to bring shame upon the Boss!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I hope so, but... compared to the number
of people my father protected, I still have a long way to go.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I want to show even more people!
The strength and magnificence of justice!
